{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.70

|arg= global

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Collects all loaded [[magazines]] from all [[handgunWeapon]] muzzles and returns them in [[Array]], otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

|s1= [[handgunMagazine]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>hint str handgunMagazine player; // ["16Rnd_9x21_Mag"]</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
_array = handgunMagazine player;
if (count _array > 0) then {
	hint ("Handgun is loaded with " + (_array select 0) + "!");
} else {
	if (handgunWeapon player != "") then {
		hint "Handgun is not loaded!";
	} else {
		hint "Player doesn't have a handgun!";
	};
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[handgunWeapon]] [[handgunItems]] [[addHandgunItem]] [[removeHandgunItem]] [[removeAllHandgunItems]] [[primaryWeaponMagazine]] [[secondaryWeaponMagazine]] [[binocularMagazine]]
}}
